title: Tranced out of Time
description:
The ticking of a clock can be extremely hypnotic. The repetitive, driving rhythm. Tick. Tock. That alone can hypnotize you. Add my voice weaving a slow, languorous melody over your mind and soon, you're falling completely under the sway of the clock. But not to make you lose track of time, this file is about giving you control. About helping you to enjoy the slow passage of time. The rhythm of it, the fact that slowing down is good. Relaxing. Useful.

Let me slow down your mind, as you listen in this relaxing, peaceful file that only aims to help you find a respite from the rush of life. Fully loopable!

Includes a post-hypnotic suggestion to relax when you hear a clock.

Art by Izumi-is-Blah
author: Mistress Calia
